title: OVHcloud CLI releases swapped for a secret-stealer
summary: For up to 94 minutes on 19 October (12:47 to 14:21 UTC), the release binaries of OVHcloud CLI v0.11.0 to v0.15.0 on GitHub were replaced with a credential stealer (GlassWorm-linked, per OVHcloud). Only people who installed or updated in that window got it; about 250 downloads. Wardlatch never runs the program: it compares the file with the five compromised builds OVHcloud published and looks for the envchecker-NNNNNNNNN folder the stealer leaves in the temp directory every time it runs.

binaries.fix: Do not run an ovhcloud binary installed on 19 October: delete it and install v0.16.0 or later. The stealer copied secrets and files from this machine, so revoke and replace them: cloud keys for AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and DigitalOcean; SSH keys; Kubernetes, Docker, npm and Terraform credentials; .netrc and git credentials. Treat the histories of the AI coding tools on it (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Continue, Cody, OpenCode) as read. Updating does not revoke a key that was already copied. OVHcloud's advisory lists everything it took.
binaries.note: not one of the five compromised builds OVHcloud published (checked by its MD5; it was not run), and no envchecker folder in the temp directories
